team.name: Troy High School Mock Trial
team.description: Troy Mock Trial is aimed at introducing students to the field of law, offering real-life trial experience, and fostering effective communication skills. With a variety of roles with a variety of responsibilities, members get to learn about multiple aspects of a trial. Troy Mock Trial allows students to foster teamwork and coordination with attorney-witness examinations, organize arguments through coordinated statements, and exercise logic with spontaneous decision making in trial.

coreValues.legalStudies: Troy Mock Trial helps students acquire a working knowledge of the judicial system through hypothetical cases.
coreValues.competition: Troy Mock Trial competes in the Constitutional Rights Foundation (CRF)'s Mock Trial program.
coreValues.skills: In Mock Trial students develop their presentation skills, analytic ability, and team cooperation.

sections.title: Lawyer Overview
sections.description: Check out our slides on attorney tactics and skills! The pretrial attorneys presents an oral argument against the motion brought by the defense. Trial attorneys control the presentation of evidence at a trial and argue the merits of their side of the case.

sections.title: Witness Overview
sections.description: Check out our slides on witness tactics and skills! The witness is used by the attorneys as unique stories that are able to convince the jury and judge that the attorney's argument has validity.
